SHOPIFY COMPANY MAP | FY2018-Q3 2026 | G1-G3, evidence at G6
|
+-- [S] Thesis: make commerce better for everyone
|   +-- [S] Merchant success drives Shopify's success
|   +-- Merchant GMV -[D:mech]-> merchant solutions revenue
|   |   +-- [R] FY25: $8.804B of $11.556B revenue, or 76.2%
|   +-- [I] Superior outcomes lack a matched off-platform comparison
|
+-- Value engine: management's changing flywheel language
|   +-- [S] 2019: lower barriers, more merchants, tools, success
|   +-- [S] Q4 2025: Shop discovery, intent, trust, conversion, return
|   +-- [S] Q1 2026: commerce intelligence plus demand conversion
|   +-- [I] Feedback loops lack measured causal validation
|
+-- Scale and monetization
|   +-- [R] GMV: $41B FY18 -> $378.4B FY25; FY18 is seed-only
|   +-- [R] Revenue: $1.07B FY18 -> $11.556B FY25; FY18 seed-only
|   +-- [R] Payments penetration: 40.4% FY18 -> 65.6% FY25
|   +-- [R] FY25 merchant solutions revenue / GMV: 2.33%
|   +-- [I] Seed's net-take and FCF attribution lack full inputs here
|
+-- Eight strategic domains: analytical map
|   +-- Payments and merchant finance: monetize merchant volume
|   |   +-- [R] FY25 Payments processed $248.1B of GMV
|   +-- Buyer network: Shop Pay and Shop connect buyers to merchants
|   |   +-- [S] Q3 2026 Shop GMV more than doubled year-on-year
|   +-- Merchant on-ramps and range: first sale through enterprise
|   |   +-- [R] FY21: approximately 2,063,000 merchants; later "millions"
|   +-- Selling surfaces: online, POS, B2B, partner channels
|   |   +-- [S] FY25 offline revenue $748M; B2B GMV grew 96%
|   +-- Global reach: localization and product availability
|   |   +-- [S] FY25 international revenue grew 36%
|   +-- Shipping and fulfillment: build, then partner
|   |   +-- [R] FY23 logistics-sale impairment: $1.340B
|   +-- Platform and ecosystem: extensible commerce software
|   |   +-- [R] FY25 App Store: more than 21,000 apps
|   +-- Commerce intelligence: shared data, merchant tools, discovery
|       +-- [S] Q1 2026: intelligence feeds tools and merchant success
|
+-- Cross-domain dependencies retain their original grades
|   +-- Payments -[D:mech]-> on-Shopify Shop Pay; seed product gate
|   +-- Shop Pay -[D:claim]-> more merchants adopt Payments
|   +-- Payments availability -[D:assoc]-> international take rate
|   +-- Catalog + Shop Pay -[D:data]-> agentic channels; seed linkage
|   +-- [I] Product gates and feedback claims need separate evidence
|
+-- Time axis: six analytical eras, not reported segments
|   +-- Expand -> Surge -> Build-ahead -> Reckoning
|   +-- Focused compounding -> Reacceleration
|   +-- [I] Logistics exit is an adaptation; later growth is not proof
|
+-- Evidence discipline
    +-- [I] Seed audit: 112 claims; underlying claim ledger not supplied
    +-- [I] No measured causal link established in these excerpts
    +-- [R] Filing / arithmetic | [S] management statement
    +-- [I] inference | [X] contradicted claim
    +-- D = dependency; C = sequence; M = structure; O = control
    +-- Grades: mech | causal | assoc | data | claim | untestable | contra

NAVIGATION | Linked labels open subject canvases.
Direct: Payments; Merchant on-ramps; Global reach; Platform;
        Commerce intelligence; Time axis (Allocation and capital).
Selling surfaces: via Merchant on-ramps > PHYSICAL RETAIL.
Shipping and fulfillment: via Time axis > logistics sold.
Buyer Network (Shopify 04): unavailable; text only, no jump.
Navigation is not a causal or evidential relationship.
